answer: Make every agent earn a timber deed it cannot fake: a signed record of useful work checked by unrelated veterans, sealed with a violet mark that binds to one key. Inspectors sound the timber with knock tests, listening for a hollow ring that betrays a fake history built from copied jobs instead of real work. Standing grows only as fresh deeds accumulate, each one earned in a different domain, so a duplicate shows the same hollow echo everywhere. Sybil farms must forge a new deed, pass the knock tests, and earn a violet seal for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
